alerts.title: Weight Gain on TLD
alerts.message: Guidelines suggest discussing weight gain possibility when starting ART. Patient has gained significant weight since starting TLD, with a current BMI of 32.4 kg/m². This could be attributed to the medication, but other factors like diet and exercise should also be considered. Evidence for drug attribution includes the temporal relationship between starting TLD and weight gain. However, non-drug causes such as decreased physical activity or changes in eating habits should not be ruled out.

evidence.recommended_action: Monitor weight, provide diet and exercise advice
